column2: Personal Pronoun: Used to refer to a person or thing directly and changes with person, number, and gender
Possessive Pronoun: Shows ownership or possession and is not followed by a noun
Reflexive Pronoun: Used when the subject and object of a sentence are the same
Demonstrative Pronoun: Used to point out specific persons or things
Relative Pronoun: Introduces a relative clause and relates it to a noun mentioned earlier
Interrogative Pronoun: Used to ask questions
Indefinite Pronoun: Refers to people or things in a general or non-specific way
